name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 8 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 60 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-11-20, at wavelengths from 0.82 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
